statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations accompanied by episodes of dizziness and giddiness that have persisted despite initial evaluation.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered for continuous ambulatory monitoring.
The service is to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity.
The diagnoses are R00.2 and R42.
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197.
The denial reason is that required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
